point.title: 频度副词
point.summary: 频度副词表示动作发生的频繁程度:always(总是)、usually(通常)、often(经常)、sometimes(有时)、never(从不)。位置:放在实义动词之前(He often plays.),但放在 be 动词之后(He is never late.)。提问频率用 how often。never 本身表否定,不再与 not 连用。表频率的短语(every day, twice a week)通常放在句末。
point.examples: She always helps her mum. / He is never late. / How often do you play sports?

questions.stem: Ann ____ walks to school. She does it every day.
questions.explanation: “每天都”表示频率最高,用 always。

questions.stem: Ben ____ drinks coffee. He doesn't drink it at all.
questions.explanation: “一点也不喝”表示从不,用 never。

questions.stem: We ____ go swimming, only now and then.
questions.explanation: “偶尔”用 sometimes。

questions.stem: My father ____ gets home at six; he does so almost every day.
questions.explanation: “几乎每天”用 usually。

questions.stem: Lily ____ reads English books; she reads them many times a week.
questions.explanation: “一周很多次”用 often。

questions.stem: Kate ____ goes to bed at nine; she does so almost every night.
questions.explanation: “几乎每晚”用 usually。

questions.stem: My mother ____ cooks nice food. We enjoy it every day.
questions.explanation: “每天都”用 always。

questions.stem: He ____ plays computer games, maybe once a month.
questions.explanation: “大约一个月一次”用 sometimes。

questions.stem: Tom is a good student. He is ____ late for class; he always comes on time.
questions.explanation: “总是准时”即从不迟到,be 动词后用 never。

questions.stem: — ____ do you play sports? — Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 提问频率用 how often。

questions.stem: My English teacher is ____ kind to us; she helps everyone every day.
questions.explanation: be 动词后接频度副词;“每天都帮”用 always。

questions.stem: They ____ help others; they do good things many times a week.
questions.explanation: 实义动词前接频度副词;“一周很多次”用 often。

questions.stem: My uncle works far away. He is ____ at home from Monday to Friday.
questions.explanation: 离家远,周一到五几乎不在家,be 动词后用 never。

questions.stem: — How often does your sister go swimming? — She goes ____.
questions.explanation: how often 提问频率,答句用频率短语 twice a week。

questions.stem: My grandma ____ watches TV in the evening; she watches it many times a week.
questions.explanation: 实义动词前接频度副词;“很多次”用 often。

questions.stem: We have an English lesson ____.
questions.explanation: 表频率的短语 every day 放在句末。

questions.stem: I visit my uncle ____.
questions.explanation: 表频率短语 twice a week 放句末。

questions.stem: — Does Lily ever eat fast food? — No, she ____ eats it.
questions.explanation: never 本身表否定,不再加 doesn't。

questions.stem: — How often does Ben go to the library? — He ____ goes there, about three times a week.
questions.explanation: often 放实义动词 goes 之前;一周三次频率高,不用 never。

questions.stem: Mr Li is a busy doctor. He is ____ free from Monday to Friday, but he ____ takes us to the park on Sundays.
questions.explanation: 周一到周五忙,be 动词后用 never;周日“有时”带我们去,实义动词前用 sometimes。
